_comment: Mods the PC watcher builds and the Steam Decks install. Temporary pack loader: every mod's zip goes to this repo's test-latest release (StardewEnergistics-test.zip, the others <name>-test.mod, also zips); the Decks install all of them. Add a mod: copy an entry. project = the SMAPI mod's .csproj (its manifest.json sits next to it).
